decode.note: the rate is from an instrumented metadata pass, not a TPS result

checkpoint.weight_identity_scope: configuration bytes plus shard names/sizes/mtime_ns; not weight-byte hashes

measurement_scope.recording_window: the eager prefill pass plus CUDA-graph capture passes; steady eager decode is skipped because a captured replay does not re-enter Python

scope: metadata census of the projections a real TP8 checkpoint calls in prefill and capture setup; every call delegates unchanged; no throughput claim
traffic_caveat: weight_bytes_one_call is out_features*in_features*itemsize for ONE call of a shape, not measured HBM traffic. The rows of one projection are issued back to back, so a matrix that fits in the card's L2 can already be reused across them; do not multiply the whole model's dense bytes by a row count and call that DRAM traffic.
